campaign.jobDescription:
Senior Backend Engineer - AI Platform
Northlane Technologies
Islamabad, Pakistan (Hybrid) | Full-time

ABOUT THE ROLE
Northlane is building an AI-native document intelligence platform used by
insurance and legal teams across EMEA. You will own the backend services that
sit between our ingestion pipeline and our retrieval layer, and you will be
accountable for the latency, correctness and cost of everything behind the API
boundary.

REQUIREMENTS
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and
  operating production backend systems.
- Strong hands-on expertise with Python and FastAPI (3+ years) for building
  high-throughput REST APIs.
- Deep PostgreSQL experience including query optimization, indexing strategy
  and execution plan analysis.
- Production deployment experience on a major cloud platform (AWS / GCP / Azure).
- Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience integrating LLM and RAG pipelines into production applications.

NICE TO HAVE
- CI/CD automation experience (GitHub Actions / Jenkins).
- Experience with distributed task queues or message brokers
  (Kafka / RabbitMQ / Celery).
- Observability tooling experience (Prometheus / Grafana / Datadog).

WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive salary, hybrid working, annual learning budget, and equity for
senior hires.
